name: node-express-react-native-template
description: Full-stack template: Node.js + Express API + React Native (iOS, Android, Web) in one repo

scripts.build: npm --prefix resources/views install && npm run build:web
scripts.dev:web: cd resources/views && cmd /c "npx expo export --platform web && copy serve.json dist\" && npx serve -s dist -l 8081
scripts.dev:full:web: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:web: cd resources/views && npx expo export --platform web && node ../../scripts/mobile/copy-web-build.cjs
scripts.prebuild:android: cd resources/views && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install
scripts.prebuild:ios: cd resources/views && npx expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run mobile:setup && npm run prebuild:android && npm run android:apk
scripts.build:android:aab: npm run mobile:setup && npm run prebuild:android && npm run android:aab
scripts.build:ios:ipa: npm run prebuild:ios && npm run ios:ipa
scripts.eas:android:apk: cd resources/views && eas build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.eas:android:aab: cd resources/views && eas build --platform android --profile production
scripts.eas:ios:ipa: cd resources/views && eas build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.migrate:seed: npm run migrate && npm run seed
